_comment: Sample live state for previewing the book. It is NOT published and NOT part of book.json. Each top-level key is a db collection and each inner key a document id, in the shapes from references/data-model.md. Use it two ways: (1) node scripts/build.mjs examples/sample-book --demo examples/sample-book/db-seed.json --preview embeds it, and the page shows it, labelled as sample data, only when the db is not available (local preview); (2) after a real publish, write the same documents with ArtifactData to see the live page. The status docs say: wave 1 is done with proof, wave 2 is building (csv presets doing, pdf worker in review, the dialog blocked on the dialog-placement decision), waves 3 and 4 have not started. _names maps the made-up user ids to names for the preview only.
